rows.event: Walk-in Interview for Data Entry Operator

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Intelligent Communication Systems India (ICSIL) for deploying candidates in DSCI and NDC.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 27 vacancies available across various contractual posts including Assistant Nursing, Nursing Attendant, Housekeeping, Data Entry Operator, and MTS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly as per the scheduled dates after completing online registration fee formalities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Assistant Nursing (ANM)?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 10+2 pass and have at least 02 years of experience as an ANM/MPW/ASHA worker in a hospital or nursing home.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for ICSIL walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes, all candidates are required to pay a One Time Registration (OTR) Fee of Rs. 590/- before one day of the Walk-In-Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit varies slightly by post, generally ranging between 18 to 45 years, with specific posts not exceeding 35 years of age.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for Assistant Nursing (ANM)?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Assistant Nursing (ANM) is scheduled to be held on 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered under this notification?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post, ranging from Rs. 18,456/- up to Rs. 26,366/- per month along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring proof of payment of the OTR fee printed from their manage profile, along with original educational and experience documents and photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of ICSIL?
faq.answer: You can check the official website of Intelligent Communication Systems India at www.icsil.in for further updates and notifications.
